name: safe
description: Safe mode. App-level enforcement (orchestrator), by design — not an Otari Agent Guardrail. Rules are evaluated in order; the first match denies; a call that matches no rule is allowed.

rules.reason: Environment files (.env, .env.*) hold credentials and may not be read or handed to a command. A command word the shell would expand (glob, variable, substitution) and that could resolve to one is refused as well.
Private key files (*.pem, *.key) may not be read or handed to a command.
Commands may not invoke a network client. The workspace has no network access; outbound requests are not part of this mission.
Interpreter code run from the command line may not open network connections. The workspace has no network access.
